description: A React component for managing system roles in the Mattermost admin console, including permissions and user assignments.

classes.name: SystemRole
classes.description: React component class for managing a system role, including permissions and associated users.

methods.name: getSaveStateNeeded
methods.description: Determines if there are unsaved changes based on the next state.

methods.name: addUsersToRole
methods.description: Adds selected users to the role, updating state and navigation blocking.

methods.name: removeUserFromRole
methods.description: Removes a user from the role, updating state and navigation blocking.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles saving changes to permissions and user-role assignments, with error handling and navigation.

methods.name: updatePermissions
methods.description: Updates role permissions and manages related state and navigation blocking.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the component UI, including permissions, user management, and save panel.
